objectives.summary: Weigh multi-agent designs for production: supervisors, workers, parallel dispatch, isolation, handoffs, approvals; diagnose their failures.
Keep long-running agents alive across crashes, restarts and model upgrades using checkpoints, persisted sessions and memory design.
Use cost, uptime and output-quality figures to decide when a live system should move between workflow and agent styles; set standards.
Pick a context policy for agents close to size or spend limits: deferred tool loading, memory, compaction, editing and cache-safe changes.

domains.name: Production Integration, Reliability, and Knowledge Grounding

objectives.summary: Build resilient Claude integrations: retries with backoff, circuit breakers, degraded modes and fallbacks that tell failure causes apart.
Size high-volume workloads: queues, backpressure, batch pipelines, tenant quotas and capacity; find which limit actually binds.
Operate MCP servers and manage change: remote auth, tool versioning, model migrations, prompt releases, staged rollout and rollback.
Design grounded knowledge apps: embeddings, chunking, reranking, hybrid search, citations, agentic search vs RAG; trace faults to a stage.
Instrument Claude systems for debugging within privacy limits: agent and tool traces, spend and token metrics, logs, content capture.
Derive SLIs and SLOs from LLM service signals; set up alerts and dashboards; catch quality drift, regressions and odd usage after updates.
Mine large volumes of traces through sampling, aggregation and failure cohorts to expose systemic problems single traces never show.
Work from evidence to locate a fault in model, harness, tools or data across multi-turn, multiagent, flaky runs, refusals, retrieval gaps.
Handle an outage or quality slide: triage, mitigate, roll back, communicate, then feed the lessons into evals, monitoring and postmortems.
Design offline eval suites: golden sets, regression runs, CI gates, retrieval and groundedness scores, release bars; keep them valid.
Judge model-graded evaluators against human labels: calibration, rubrics, bias, rater agreement and drift between model versions.
Measure quality on live traffic through sampling, A/B tests and feedback loops, choosing metrics that suit each kind of task.

domains.name: Cost and Latency Optimization at Scale

objectives.summary: Cut fleet spend using usage data: forecasts, model-tier routing and cascades, caching diagnostics, batch economics, tenant budgets.
Profile latency against a target, splitting first-token delay from total time; use streaming, parallel tools, cache points, effort tuning.
Judge layered guardrails against an agent's risk: sandboxes, approvals, hook policies, filters, PII redaction, refusal fallbacks and tuning.
Assess how agents reading untrusted content can be attacked: injection, poisoning, exfiltration, risky autonomy; layer defences, red team.

domains.name: Agent Fleet Operations for Software Delivery

objectives.summary: Fan big engineering jobs out to parallel agents in separate worktrees; split tasks, plan merges and conflicts, read fleet telemetry.
Run verification when generation outruns review: trial AI code review quietly, calibrate against humans, then gate merges with oversight.
Operate unattended agents on goals, timers or events such as CI failures, with checkpoints, notifications and escalation paths.
Configure coding agents org-wide: managed settings, MCP allow lists, usage telemetry, gateway routing, quality rules for shared prompts.
